specs.title: Example catalog groups every original model, filters categories and searches descriptions or block names
Example selection remains compatible with the original popup buttons and keyboard search
Quick insert and example triggers show names without shortcut or text caret decorations
Example picker stays within both theme viewports and does not edit behind its search
Expanded vector-statistics example produces real raw Worker results after catalog selection
Expanded matrix-diagonal-selection example produces real raw Worker results after catalog selection
Expanded dead-zone-quantizer-sinc example produces real raw Worker results after catalog selection
Expanded chirp-sweep source example records its sampled mathematical signal through the Worker
Expanded signal-curves source example records its sampled mathematical signal through the Worker
M10 typed integer fields preserve 64-bit edits, block invalid drafts, save/import, and download CSV/TS

Desktop and horizontal tablet keep full-height results beside the canvas; narrow screens stack them

Reduced motion preserves run status while disabling the logo CSS animation
M1 learning examples retain typed values, full matrix elements, formulas and units

Multiple selection copies internal edges, creates unique IDs and deletes as one undo command
Dynamic Demux ports preserve producer output IDs and parameter edits remove obsolete edges reversibly
